prompt: rust repr packed struct nested repr align member restriction
answer:
Historically, Rust forbade a `#[repr(packed)]` struct or union from containing a field whose type—and transitively, any nested type—had `#[repr(align(...))]`:

```rust
#[repr(align(16))]
struct Aligned(i32);

#[repr(packed)]
struct Packed(Aligned); // historically rejected
```

This was diagnosed as:

> packed type cannot transitively contain a `#[repr(align)]` type

The reverse nesting was allowed:

```rust
#[repr(packed)]
struct Packed(i32);

#[repr(align(16))]
struct Aligned(Packed); // allowed
```

`#[repr(align(N))]` and `#[repr(packed(N))]` also cannot be applied to the same type. However, the current Rust source notes that error E0588 is no longer emitted; the provided results do not specify the replacement behavior.
